entrance.name: Newaygo County Parks Motor Vehicle Permit

values.note: 2026 Newaygo County rates: electric site $31 a night Mon-Wed (non-holiday), $36 Thu-Sun; 21 days $680; season $1,650; one rate for everyone. Holidays and special events +$5 a night. Rustic sites ($18-23) are tent-only on the county map. A Motor Vehicle Permit is required for each day a vehicle is in the park: $8 daily, $24 for 3 days, $35 annual. $5 reservation fee on every reservation; cancelling costs $25.

fees.source: https://www.newaygocountymi.gov/departments/parks/rates-fees/ ('2026 Camping Fees', Ed Henning table: Campsite (Electric) $36 Nightly (Th-Su), $31 Nightly (M-W) Non-Holiday, $680 21-Day, $1,650 Seasonal; 'Reservation fee (Applies to all reservations) – $5.00'; 'A valid Newaygo County Motor Vehicle Permit is required for each day a vehicle is in the park'; 'HOLIDAYS AND SPECIAL EVENTS ASSESSED AN ADDITIONAL $5.00 PER NIGHT') + Ed Henning page ('Daily MVP $8', '3-Day MVP $24', 'Annual MVP $35') + campground map key ('Rustic - Tent only'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: County map: about 60 numbered sites, electric (some electric tent-only), plus rustic tent-only sites, camping cabins and a group site.

sites.source: https://www.newaygocountymi.gov/download/ed-henning-campground-map-pdf/?wpdmdl=4420 (map key: Cabin, Electric, Electric - Tent only, Rustic - Tent only; sites numbered 1-60), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Booked on the county's Firefly page, or by phone (231) 689-7340 / the campground in season. Online bookings need 2 nights; 'For 1-night reservations, you must call your Park of choice.' Holidays need 3 nights and are non-refundable. 2026 online reservations opened January 5. Seasonal sites by waiting list.

booking.source: https://www.newaygocountymi.gov/departments/parks/rates-fees/ ('All campsite and cabin reservations require a 2-night minimum (3 nights on holidays)', 'For 1-night reservations, you must call your Park of choice') + https://app.fireflyreservations.com/reserve/property/EHCountyPark ('Holidays are assessed an additional $5.00 per night and require a 3-night minimum') + park-reservations page, read 2026-10-25

note: Newaygo County park on the Muskegon River (500 Croton Rd, Newaygo). Grass sites; the boat launch is open year-round (county vehicle permit needed, also for dropping off tubers and kayakers). --Claude
summary: County pages + map + Firefly front page: confirmed $31-36 electric (rustic sites are tent-only, so the electric site is the base), dump, reservable; added $5 reservation fee, $8/day vehicle permit, season May 1 - Oct 11, the 3-night holiday minimum and the online-only 2-night rule (1 night by phone), Firefly link. Firefly's search is behind reCAPTCHA, so no per-site lengths or amps. Seasonal sites by waiting list, count not given (passes test 4). Note trimmed of counts, season, permit and booking.
flags: Phone: 231-652-1202 is the campground in season (5/1-10/11); before and after the season the county parks office is (231) 689-7340.
